title: Unclear default for `[storage]driver=`
body:
For `[storage]driver=` https://github.com/containers/storage/blob/main/docs/containers-storage.conf.5.md#storage-table says:

> This field is required to guarantee proper operation.  … . When the system configuration uses an unsupported rootless driver, rootless users default to "overlay" if available, otherwise "vfs". 

vendor/go.podman.io/storage/storage.conf ⇔ https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/blob/main/storage/storage.conf contains:

```
[storage]

# Default storage driver. Optional.
# driver = "overlay"
```

When I install `gitlab-runner` and I have podman 6.1.1-dev I see
```
>>> gitlab-ci-multi-runner: the service is not installed
>>> Runtime platform                                    arch=amd64 os=linux pid=2111179 revision=03e25374 version=19.3.3
>>> Runtime platform                                    arch=amd64 os=linux pid=2111517 revision=03e25374 version=19.3.3
>>> INFO: docker not found, checking for podman...
>>> INFO: podman found, using podman
>>> time="2026-09-15T16:29:35+03:00" level=warning msg="The storage 'driver' option should be set in /etc/containers/storage.conf. A driver was picked automatically."
>>> time="2026-09-15T16:29:35+03:00" level=warning msg="The storage 'driver' option should be set in /etc/containers/storage.conf. A driver was picked automatically."
>>>
```

On one place it is articulated, that the field is required to guarantee proper operation, on another is spelled that the field is optional and suggested that it defaults to `"overlay"`.  At runtime the warning “The storage 'driver' option should be set in /etc/containers/storage.conf. A driver was picked automatically.” is produced.

* For consistency, it should be spelled that missing `driver` implies "overlay", with fallback to `"vfs"` and there should be no warning.
* If the warning remains, it should spell what driver was picked automatically (vfs, overlay, something else)

comments.body:
Since podman 6 the storage driver is not required for proper functioning.

> The storage 'driver' option should be set in /etc/containers/storage.conf. A driver was picked automatically

The warning no longer exists in the code since podman 6 so you are not using that code in that case

> The warning no longer exists in the code since podman 6 so you are not using that code in that case
